userInteractions.userRequest: Repos won't exist locally and need to be cloned. Steps 3 & 4 should be in a subprocess of single-repo codebase investigation
userInteractions.agentResponse: Updating design to: 1) Handle repo cloning in preparation step, 2) Use subprocess pattern for per-repo investigation (spawn investigate-single-repo subprocess for each repo), 3) Parent aggregates results after all subprocesses complete
userInteractions.reasoning: Better architecture: subprocess isolation for each repo investigation, cleaner orchestration, handles remote repos properly

userInteractions.userRequest: Step 2 should be in subprocess. Don't clone all repos in advance - clone on-demand per subprocess and remove after investigation (only if cloned, not local paths)
userInteractions.agentResponse: Updating design: 1) Parent Step 2 becomes 'Parse Repository List' (lightweight), 2) Subprocess handles 'Prepare Repository' (clone if URL), 3) Subprocess adds cleanup step to remove cloned repos, 4) No cloneDirectory parameter needed
userInteractions.reasoning: Optimal architecture: minimal disk usage, on-demand cloning per subprocess, automatic cleanup, subprocess fully self-contained

userInteractions.userRequest: The tracking in step 3 can be in the repositories-list file and not in the memory
userInteractions.agentResponse: Updating design: Step 3 updates repositories-list.json with subprocess tracking (subProcessId, status, subProcessPath) instead of parent memory. Cleaner data organization.
userInteractions.reasoning: Better data locality - subprocess tracking belongs with the repo list itself, not separate in memory
